bagPolicy.summary: Bags larger than 30cm x 40cm x 20cm are prohibited. Rucksacks and backpacks are not allowed, and there is no storage facility for prohibited items.
allowed: Bags up to 30cm wide x 20cm long x 20cm deep
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: On-site parking at Utilita Arena Sheffield often sells out in advance, so it's recommended to purchase parking tickets online beforehand for guaranteed reserved parking. Parking is for one admission only, and re-entry is not allowed.

rideshare.note: To arrange a taxi, call Veezu on 0114 239 39 39. The venue lists this operator on its public transport page.

concessions.note: Utilita Arena Sheffield offers a variety of food and drink options with a focus on fresh, tasty, and locally sourced products. Gluten-free and vegan options are available, and all outlets are cashless, accepting only card payments.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Wheelchair accessible and essential companion tickets can be booked online through Ticketmaster, or call the Accessible booking line on 0114 256 5593, Monday to Friday, 10am to 4pm. Tell the venue your needs when booking. Accessible seating is step-free on concourse level, near exits and toilets, and ambulant seats with a few steps are also available.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Unless your ticket says otherwise, it allows a single admission, so once you're scanned in you can't leave and come back.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Tickets are in the Utilita Arena Sheffield app, where you sign in with your Ticketmaster account; they aren't emailed, printable, or held at the box office. The in-person box office is open on event days only.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Enter via the external stairs up to the concourse. If you need help with stairs, use the lifts at ground floor Entries B and C or the external ramp on the Blue side of the building near Entry C.
